title: Best cash back credit cards
audience_line: For people who want simple rewards without tracking points.
intro: Cash back cards are the most straightforward way to earn rewards on what you already buy. We prefer cards with no annual fee and a flat earning rate, or category cards that offer high rates where you spend the most.

picks.why: It gives you 2% on everything. No categories to remember, no caps to worry about. You get 1% when you buy and 1% when you pay.
Earning 3% back at restaurants and drugstores makes this a powerful addition to your wallet without paying a fee.

title: Best credit cards for groceries
audience_line: For families and home cooks who spend a lot at the supermarket.
intro: Groceries are a major household expense. The right card can return hundreds of dollars a year. Pay attention to caps and annual fees.

picks.why: The 6% rate on US supermarkets up to $6,000 per year is unmatched. Even with the annual fee, you come out ahead if you spend near the cap.
